author: PlayStation
description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/fatal-fury-city-of-the-wolves/

Code Name: Blue Mary.
Mission: Forge a new legend in South Town.
The ever-memorable Blue Mary debuted in 1995's FATAL FURY 3: Road to the Final Victory, boasting an intense combination of physical strength and Commando Sambo mastery. Apply pressure with a variety of grappling techniques, from dexterous throws to crushing submissions, in adrenaline-charged contests that only City of the Wolves can deliver.

BLUE MARY
Voice Actors: Allegra Clark (EN), Sarah Emi Bridcutt (JA)
Special agent active in South Town. With another case under her belt, Blue Mary decides to take some much-needed time off—until Geese's legacy and the Sacred Scrolls force an about-face. Knowing that duty calls, she revs her motorbike and rides into investigative action once more, inescapable Commando Sambo at the ready. Foes beware—get caught in her web and all you can do is pray that you’ll walk away in one piece.

About FATAL FURY: City of the Wolv

description:

Post-apocalyptic online vehicular combat game Crossout just received a “Rust & Dust” major update that features a brand new event, the likes of which the Wasteland has never seen before. In the “Rust & Dust” Tale, you and other players will be able to experience the thrill of discovery once again and journey through an alternate version of the Wasteland that lives by its own rules: faster progression and simplified acquisition of parts, a chance to produce many parts for the main game, including a brand new iconic legendary cabin, and no sci-fi stuff at all - just harsh, classic post-apocalypse!
